definitions.short: Elam , a son of Shem and his descendants, with their country; also of six Israelites
definitions.full: H5867. Eylam I. עֵילָם proper name, of a people et. terr. Elam , Αιλαμ , Ἐλαμεῖραι , well-known country and people northeast of Lower Tigris (Assyrian Elamtu Dl Pa 320 ff. COT Gen 10:22 ); — as early invaders of Palestine 14:1 , 9 , allies of Assyr. Isa 22:6 ; foe of Babylon 21:2 ; abode of dispersed Israelites 11:11 ; prophesied against Jer 49:34-35 , 36 (twice in verse) (Qr, Kt עולם ), 49:37 ; 49:38 ; 49:39 ; Ezek 32:24 , compare ע ׳כָּלמַֿלְכֵי Jer 25:25 ; called 'son' of Shem Gen 10:22 (P) = 1Chr 1:17 ; purely local designation ׳ע הַמְּדִינָה Dan 8:2 . II. עֵילָם proper name, masculine Ηλαμ , Αιλαμ : 1 heads of families of returned exiles: a. Ezra 2:7 = Neh 7:12 . b. Ezra 2:31 = Neh 7:34 . c. Ezra 8:7 ; 10:2 (Qr; Kt עולם ), 10:26 . 2. a chief of people Neh 10:15 . 3 name in Benjamin 1Chr 8:24 . 4 Levite name 1Chr 26:3 . 5 a priest Neh 12:42 .
definitions.rootNote: or עוֹלָם ; (Ezra 10:2; Jeremiah 49:36), probably from 5956 ; hidden, i.e. distant;
